[h3]2. Lovense App[/h3] Connect any Lovense toys through the Lovense app on your phone to the game over your wifi network.

[h2]Buttplug.io Connection[/h2]

You can connect to your toy directly through the game, which does not require any app and does not require use of Intiface Central.

1. [b]Disconnect Apps -[/b] Make sure any phone or PC apps that normally connect to your toy are not active before you try to connect it to the game (including Intiface Central)

2. [b]Enable Butplug.io - [/b]Inside the journal in the game, select the vibrating buttplug bookmark then select ‘Enable Buttplug.io'. The game will automatically start listening for toys and list any it finds on the right.

3. [b]Put Toy in Pairing Mode -[/b] Put your bluetooth-enable toy into pairing mode. This is usually done by holding down the power button when the toy is off until it’s light starts flashing, though your specific toy may be different.

4. [b]Wait for the Toy to Appear -[/b] The toy name should pop up on the opposite page in the journal, which is confirming that the toy is connected.

5. [b]Test the Toy -[/b] You can select the toy’s name to send a quick buzz to make sure it’s active and connected.

6. [b]Play the Game -[/b] You can simply start playing from there. Any toy-enabled animations and interactions should now trigger the toy as well.


[h2]Lovense App Connection[/h2]

You can connect any Lovense toy to the game via a phone app. This is particularly useful when you are using Lovense toys and your PC doesn’t have a bluetooth adapter.

1.[b] Connect Toy to Lovense App -[/b] Connect toy Lovense toy to your app as you normally would to control it with your phone.

2. [b] Enable LAN in App -[/b] In the Lovense App on your phone, go to the ‘Discover’ section and select ‘Game Mode’, then turn on the ‘Enable LAN’.

3. [b] Enable Lovense in Game -[/b] Inside the journal in the game, select the vibrating buttplug bookmark then select ‘Enable Lovesen App’.

4. [b] Select Lovense App in List - [/b]Your lovense app is matching info from the ‘Enable LAN’ screen should show up in the game. If it isn’t automatically selected, select the Lovense App. You should now see a list of toys you’ve connected to the app and they should all be enabled in the game.

5. [b] Test the Toy -[/b] Select any connected toys from the toy list below the app list. You should experience a quick buzz to make sure it’s connected and responding as you would expect.

6. [b]Play the Game -[/b] You can simply start playing from there. Any toy-enabled animations and interaction should now trigger the toy as well.

notes.title: Developer and Game News
notes.content:
[h3]Hello to all our fans and players of our game![/h3]

We are long overdue to share with all of you where we are with game development and when you can expect to receive new content. To help explain this, we also feel it’s important to share with you some of what has been going on with us as developers. For a more detailed update, please read to the end. For those who just want the highlights, we’ll start with those first!

[h2]Highlights: [/h2]

[b]Dominatrix Simulator release coming August 15, 2022.[/b]

New content will be minimal, but there will be new scenes to play, as well as new music, new animations, and several bug fixes.

Scenes with The Divine Engine Pragma and Enforcer Furia will be playable in alpha state, along with the first introduction of a Mistress ‘walking’ in game.

[b]New builds to come bi-monthly.[/b]

Devilish Domina is now full-time on the game and will be managing the regular release of content and fixes in a new release every two months.

[b]2022 has been a difficult year so far.[/b]

A number of extreme obstacles hit the developers, Deviant Dev and Devilish Domina, in the first six months of ‘22, slowing down development and exposing players to risk. These are resolved (you can read more below), so we expect things to get back on track for the last half of the year.

[h2]Detailed Updates:[/h2]

[b]Personal challenges.[/b]

In December, 2021, Deviant and Domina (real life partners) began a journey to move overseas from New Zealand, their home for the last 6 years, to find a new home back in the United States, their home country.

Just at the end of January, Domina had a significant health crisis that required serious intervention involving a risky surgery and took several months to recover from. She is now in extremely good condition and her recovery has gone exceptionally well.

During her recovery, a Discord hacker took over her account and wiped out the game’s Discord community, took control of the game’s Itch account, and attempted to divert game proceeds to their own personal account. The hacker also uploaded a corrupt file to Itch. The developers and their Discord moderator team worked feverishly over 48 hours to block every attempt the hacker made, take back control, and rebuild the Discord server. To our best understanding, player impact was extremely minimal, but the risk was terrifying to encounter.

Further complicating matters was the challenge of finding a place to live. Just one week after moving into a place, their next door neighbor was shot and this kicked off a series of short-term moves while spending great amounts of time and energy looking for a safer, more permanent home.

The devs can now, with relief, share that they are in their final stages of moving to a permanent home and expect the difficult challenges to be behind them.

[h3]Game progress.[/h3]

Though development has been intermittent, progress has been made in the background and you can expect regular releases to come more frequently.

In leaving New Zealand, Devilish Domina chose to take a sabbatical from her career to focus full-time on the game. This will include managing the asset pipeline, writing and voice acting stories, engaging frequently with the community, and providing creative direction to content developed for the game.

[b]Two new Mistresses will have content to be released.[/b]

Playtesting for the Introductory scene for The Divine Engine Pragma is underway with Patrons - This scene will introduce her to the player and give her a chance to inspect them as a potential new specimen for her collection! Pragma is a robotic AI Mistress, who will focus on fucking machine endurance, mind games, and body modification.

Recruitment for a new voice actress for Enforcer Furia begins the 1st week of August - two scenes introducing Furia and providing a glory_hole task for players are created and need a Latinx voice actress to bring her to life.

[b]New art assets.[/b]

Our resident artist, Just Jeff, has been pulled away on other projects for almost a year, but is now back on board creating additional art assets for our game.

The first is the completion of a brand new, never before discussed, character named Ereshkigal. We don’t want to give too much about her away, just yet, but you can expect to see some sneak peaks of her in the near future. 

For now, Pragma’s intro has a placeholder fucking machine, while Just Jeff whips up something perfect for our game. 

[b]New musical compositions completed.[/b]

For the past year, we have had a music composer, Fflewddur Fflam, creating unique sounds for each Mistress. Each one has their own unique origin, style, appearance, room, and mannerisms (not to mention their specific kink preferences), so we knew music was also key to creating their unique vibe.

Cues have been completed for each Mistress with scenes currently in the game: The Goddess, The Headmistress, Mistress Yuki-Onna, Mistress Nega-Yuki and Ms. Treatment.

New music will soon begin for Pragma and Furia!

[b]New animations in testing.[/b]

We found hundreds of amazing mocap animations that we are testing and evaluating for using in the game. 

Because of this, we’re really excited to share that we will finally have a Mistress walking in a scene, which we hope will be the future of adding more NPC motion to the game.

notes.title: A Steamy Development Update!
notes.content:
Hello, all you naughty little kinksters,

It's been a while, so we have lots to share! First of all, we can't thank you enough for your interest in Dominatrix Simulator! All your enthusiasm and positive feedback inspires us to be that much more naughty and creative for your virtual pleasure.

[h1]Art Updates[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33725826/4c39dafcec27296f9300464a389dea3c4f1576ca.jpg[/img]
One of the greatest challenges we had when we first started was finding an artist who could bring the lewd world of the Dominatrix Simulator to life through the environments and characters that inhabit the House. We are so so excited to have found an excellent professional artist who does just that! With their help, [b]we are refreshing the game with all new custom environments[/b], some of which you'll see if you try the new puppy playtest build.

All the new art is entirely funded thanks to amazing fans like you who support us on Patreon. The community's support and encouragement have enabled us to bring our debaucherous and surreal vision to life and we think you'll really enjoy the results.

[h1]Puppy Playtesting[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33725826/8a258c35364966dee2dba00167ba750799524494.png[/img]
Speaking of results, we are in our final stages of playtesting brand new content for Dominatrix Simulator. Mistress Yuki-Onna absolutely [i]loves[/i] puppies and is super-excited to train you to be her perfect little pet! In this playtest, she'll patiently teach you all the commands good puppies should follow, test you on them, and then praise you or chastise you based on your performance.

This collection of scenes represents our first foray into tasks for the player and introduces several new features and environmental art.

We will release this content publicly as a part of the full experience on Steam once it is ready, but in the meantime, if you want to get a taste of what being Yuki's good little puppy feels like, [b]you can access the playtest as a Patreon supporter here[/b]:
https://www.patreon.com/posts/31273985

If you do give it a try and have feedback or thoughts or want to connect with us and the wider Dominatrix Simulator fan community, don't hesitate to join us on our Discord Server here:
https://discord.gg/UxUDEE6

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33725826/41d5c8657e86bc1fbc69feaf46cc8ed2d8d8dc71.jpg[/img]

[b]Dual-Pose Recognition[/b]

To allow you to answer Mistress Yuki-Onna with your paws as a good little puppy should, we've updated pose recognition to differentiate between more than one pose at a time. Since puppies can't speak, you now can raise one paw for 'yes' and another paw for 'no'!

This feature will give you more ways to communicate with all Mistresses in the future and allow for much more dynamic in-game interactions!

[b]Behavioral Conditioning[/b]

The puppy play scenes in this test build are all about learning to properly act like a puppy. It is built on the concept of slave training and introduces a series of poses over time that the player can learn, practice, and even get tested on! The content gets progressively more challenging over time.

As humans, we have the most fun when learning. As it turns out, so do puppies and slaves! Feel a sense of accomplishment and pride as you build skills over time and are increasingly challenged by the Mistresses. But beware! The better you do, the harder [i]you'll[/i] get. 😘

Again, thank you so so much for your patience and support. Thanks to you, we continue to work towards that supremely immersive and deliciously kinky experience that, let's be honest, we've [i]all[/i] been searching for.

Mine truly,
Devilish Domina 💋

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33725826/9f98d8dd0d5cbc69996cc9fd3f59849a79edacd3.png[/img][h1]Hello Patrons and Fans!![/h1]

We're excited to bring more content to you in just a couple weeks! On Dec 15, patrons will get early access to the[i][b] “Learning the Ropes” [/b][/i]content we've been working on the last couple of months.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/deviantdev]Patrons [/url]will get a [i][b]special code phrase[/b][/i] in a patrons-only post to unlock content for the first 30 days. It will then be free for everyone on Jan 15, 2019. 

As our sincerest appreciation for all that our patrons have done for us and the game, patrons will always get new content first, but do keep in mind this means early access content that has some parts with placeholder assets or missing interactions.

[h1]New Mistresses and Rooms[/h1]

We're introducing the concepts for three new Mistresses with this release: the Headmistress (more on her in the next post), Yuki-Onna, and Nega-Yuki. The Headmistress is a [b]complete, custom model paid for by Patreon funds[/b]. Yuki and Nega are placeholder models for now, but will also be replaced with custom models you’ve funded as well.

Each Mistress has her own room that she plays with you in. These rooms are placeholders for now. We've commissioned two of these rooms to be custom for our game, but they aren't ready yet.

[h1]Introductory Scenes[/h1]

Every time we put a new Mistress in the game, you'll get to play through a special 'introductory' scene with her. These are story and character-driven scenes separate from the submission scenes that make up normal gameplay. You'll play through three of these: one for each of our new Mistresses.

[h1]Punishments and Rewards[/h1]

In addition to meeting each of our three new Mistresses via their intro scene, you'll be introduced to our punishment and reward gameplay system. Depending on how you perform tasks (coming in the next release), you will be given punishments or rewards for your performance. 

For this release, we guide you through this process the first time, but in the future, you will be able to choose the Mistress you want to pay off a punishment or earn a reward through.

[h1]Early Access Content vs. Polished Content[/h1]
[b]
Early Access Content [/b]includes:
- placeholder models
- placeholder rooms
- subtitles
- placeholder game mechanics via the in-game menu
- some player poses (but many will require the in-game book-menu, at first)
- static character poses with transitions (smooth animations come later)
- some sound effects
- placeholder music

Because it takes time to build this much content and polish it, as we continue to do with the introduction to our [b]Goddess[/b], please rest assured we will be working towards polished content over the next month.

[b]Polished Content [/b]includes:
- Voice over
- Animations
- Full pose support
- New game mechanics
- Full sound effects

[h1]Being Part of Game Development[/h1]

One of the major reasons we have taken this approach to release early access content is because [i][b]we are still learning what fans and players like[/b][/i]. We could spend a year building content and polishing the hell out of it, but if it's no fun to play, then we've just wasted all that time and money!!

So, we are releasing content as we create it so we can get [b]YOUR [/b]feedback about what actually works and what doesn't. We need to know if the characters are sexy, the story is compelling, the scenes turn you on, and whatever else you think makes or breaks this game!

We hope you will all welcome this approach as a chance to shape a new kind of gameplay. We couldn't do this without you!!

Thank you!

Deviant Dev and Devilish Domina
